members.name: AddBakeInstance
members.signature: public BakeInstance AddBakeInstance(BakeMesh mesh, Float4x4 worldTransform, Float2? uvOffset = null, Float2? uvScale = null, string bakeUVLayer = "UV1")

docs.summary: Place a mesh instance into this atlas page. `uvOffset` + `uvScale` transform the mesh's bake-UV layer into [0,1]^2 of the target. Default: identity (whole page).

params.mesh: The mesh to instance into this target.
params.worldTransform: Object-to-world transform applied to the mesh's vertices.
params.uvOffset: Translation applied to the bake-UV layer when sampling the atlas.
params.uvScale: Scale applied to the bake-UV layer when sampling the atlas.
params.bakeUVLayer: UV layer used for lightmap atlas placement (defaults to `"UV1"`).

docs.summary: Returns a fresh HDR snapshot of the current pixel data (R,G,B interleaved). Read after the job has succeeded.

HDR snapshot as RGBA float (alpha = 1), length `Width*Height*4`. This is the correct thing to upload to an `Rgba16f`/`Rgba32f` lightmap texture: the values stay linear HDR so the runtime multiplies them by albedo and tonemaps the whole scene afterward. Do NOT use [`ReadLDR`](#api~Prowl.Photonic.LightmapTarget~ReadLDR) for storage — it tonemaps, which is only correct for a preview.

Encode the HDR lightmap as 8-bit RGBM (RGBA8) without tonemapping: a compact lossy HDR format for shipped builds. The stored alpha carries a shared multiplier so values up to `maxRange` survive in 8 bits per channel.

Decode in the shader as `rgb * a * maxRange` (with the same `maxRange`). Sample the texture in **linear** space (no sRGB) — the data is linear radiance, not colour.

members.name: ReadLDR
members.signature: public byte[] ReadLDR(float exposure = 1f, float gamma = 1f / 2.2f)

docs.summary: Tonemapped + gamma-encoded 8-bit RGB, for **previews only**. This bakes in Reinhard tonemapping and gamma, which is wrong for storing an actual lightmap (the lightmap must stay linear HDR and be tonemapped with the rest of the scene at runtime). For storage use [`ReadHDRRGBA`](#api~Prowl.Photonic.LightmapTarget~ReadHDRRGBA) (float) or [`ReadRGBM`](#api~Prowl.Photonic.LightmapTarget~ReadRGBM) (compact 8-bit HDR).
